evals.name: SaaS Platform PRD
evals.prompt: I want to build a SaaS platform for freelance graphic designers to manage invoices and client feedback. It needs a dashboard, PDF generation, and Stripe integration.
expectations: Identifies missing user personas (e.g., 'The Client' who pays)
Suggests specific tech stack (e.g., 'Next.js + Postgres + Stripe Connect')
Defines a Data Model with relationships (Designer -> Invoices -> Items)

evals.name: Mobile App MVP
evals.prompt: Build a tinder-like app for adopting shelter dogs.
expectations: Challenges the scope if 'chat' is requested for MVP (suggests external link instead)
